title: ACTIVATING PRAYER MORNING BLESSINGS TO PROSPER AS YOU START YOUR DAY
text: Beloved, hear me this morning. God has not brought you into a new day for nothing. Every day is a gift and every morning is a prophetic gate that must be opened correctly. The Bible says in Psalm 118:4, "This is the day which the Lord had made. We will rejoice and be glad in it." That means this day is not random. It was made. It was fashioned. It was constructed by God's own hands. And in his construction plan, he factored in your victory, your lifting, and your testimony. You are not entering into this morning empty. You are entering as a child of prophecy, as a carrier of destiny, as one who must prosper. In Job 38:12-13, the Lord asks Job a very serious question. Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days? And caused the daypring to know his place, that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it. Did you hear that? The morning is to be commanded. The day must hear the voice of the redeemed. If you do not speak into your day, or others will speak. If you do not program blessings into your morning, the enemy will program trouble. So right now, we rise in the spirit to command our morning. We legislate by the authority of the blood of Jesus and we speak to creation, yield to us, favor us, prosper us, work for us. Lift your hands wherever you are and declare, "By the mercies of God, I take hold of this day. I decree the rising sun will shine for my good. I decree the wind will blow favor in my direction. I decree the earth will yield her increase onto me. No evil shall come near me. No arrow shall prosper against me in the name of Jesus. This morning, every closed gate is opening. Isaiah 60:11 says, "Therefore, thy gates shall be opened continually. They shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought. By prophecy, I decree your gates are open. The gates of finance open. The gates of favor open. The gates of opportunities open. The gates of settlement. Lift your voice in faith and say, "I decree and declare, I prosper. Today, I excel today. I rise above reproach. Today, I will not be small. I will not be weak. I will not be defeated. By the spirit of the living God, I step into abundance. By the blood of Jesus, I silence the accuser. By the fire of the Holy Ghost, I overturn every plan of darkness. This is my day of victory. Somebody under the sound of my voice, "Thus sayeth the spirit of God, today marks the beginning of your open doors. Where you have been denied before, you will be accepted. Where the door was shut, it is opening. Where your name was despised, it will be honored. Where there was rejection, there will now be acceptance. Where there was failure, there will now be success. In the name of Jesus Christ, I break every evil cycle. Psalm 30:5 says, "Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning." That means your morning is not only about the sun rising. It is about joy rising. I prophesy joy will rise in your life today. Joy will rise in your family. Joy will rise in your finances. Joy will rise in your health. Every sorrow is turned into laughter. Every delay is turned into acceleration. Every shame is turned into honor. Father, we bless you this morning. We exalt you because you are the God who loads us daily with benefits. Psalm 68:19. Today, load your people with favor, with wisdom, with strength, with divine opportunities, with supernatural preservation. Let the heavens be opened over their heads. Let the works of their hands prosper. Let their steps be ordered by the Lord. Let the oil of favor never run dry upon them. Now child of God, begin to declare over your life, I prosper today. My family prospers today. My business prospers today. My ministry prospers today. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every altar raised against me catches fire. Every arrow sent against me returns back to sender. I am a victor, not a victim. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. I decree this morning, every arrow of death fired against you is returning back to sender. Psalm 91:5-6 declares, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noonday. By this prophetic word, I decree arrows flying by day, you will not see me. Terrors of the night, you will not locate me. Destruction at noon, you will not find me. I am feeding in Christ and Christ in God. I stand in the spirit and cancel every evil plan against your family. Hear me. Every projection of premature death, every projection of sudden sickness, every projection of financial collapse, I cancel it now. The Bible says in Isaiah 8:10, "Take counsel together and it shall come to not. Speak the word and it shall not stand, for God is with us. Every demonic counsel against your home shall not stand. Every witchcraft word spoken against your destiny shall not come to pass in the mighty name of Jesus. Let fire consume them. I decree and declare this morning, your finances are delivered. Every altar that has swallowed your resources, vomit them now. Joel 2:25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar, and the palmer, my great army, which I sent among you. by the covenant of restoration. I decree every year you lost in struggle, every opportunity that slipped out of your hands, every blessing diverted by witchcraft powers, let there be restoration. You shall eat in plenty. You shall be satisfied. You shall never be ashamed again. Somebody lift your hands and say after me, by the blood of Jesus, I uproot every evil seed planted in my life. I cancel every demonic contract. I break every evil covenant. I scatter every satanic conspiracy. I declare today, my destiny is preserved. My family is preserved. My children are preserved. My health is preserved. My finances are preserved. Beloved, there are evil all. Now declare with me. I decree and declare. Today is my day of victory. Every curse is reversed. Every arrow is returned. Every altar is destroyed. Every chain is broken. I walk in liberty. I walk in favor. I walk in prosperity by the blood of Jesus. My destiny is unstoppable. Psalm 68:1 says, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him." I invoke this scripture over your life. Let God arise. Let your enemies scatter. Let witchcraft scatter. Let monitoring spirits scatter. Let evildoers scatter. This morning you step into your testimony by fire. This is your day of blessings. This is your day of restoration. This is your day of open doors. Shout a victorious amen. >> Beloved, listen carefully. There are moments when prayer must be prophetic and militant. This is one of such. Psalm 121:3 declares, "He will not suffer thy foot to be moved. He that keepeth thee will not slumber." That means even when you are asleep, the keeper of Israel is awake, waging war against the forces of darkness on your behalf. You cannot serve a God who does not slumber and still be a victim of demonic surveillance. Today, every monitoring spirit watching your progress to truncate it is judged by fire. I stand by the word of the Lord in Isaiah 49:25-26. But thus, sayeth the Lord, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered. For I will contend with him that contended with thee, and I will save thy children, and I will feed them that oppressed thee with their own flesh, and they shall be drunken with their own blood as with sweet wine. And all flesh shall know that I, the Lord, am thy Savior, and thy redeemer, the mighty one of Jacob. By this scripture I declare, every captivity you have found yourself in is broken. Now the Lord contends with them that contend with you. I decree and declare by the anointing of the Holy Ghost, every arrow of sickness fired into your body returns back to sender. Jeremiah 3:17, I turn to your finances now. Joel 2:26 declares, "And ye shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you, and my people shall never be ashamed." Every embargo placed upon your finances, I decree, let it be lifted now. Every spirit of poverty fighting your destiny, I decree, let it be destroyed now. Every altar that has swallowed your blessings, vomit them by fire. Your resources, your contracts, your opportunities, be restored in the name of Jesus. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice, financial doors that have been shut for years are opening tonight. Unusual favor is coming upon you. Men shall give into your bosom. What was denied you will be released. What was delayed will be accelerated. Receive it in the name of Jesus. >> Amen. >> Now I turn to your family. Psalm 112:2 says, "His seed shall be mighty upon earth. The generation of the upright shall be blessed. Every witchcraft power fighting the destiny of your children be judged tonight. Every arrow of waywardness, every arrow of untimely death, every arrow of stagnation fired into your family is broken in the name of Jesus. I decree restoration of marriages, restoration of broken homes, restoration of peace in families, restoration of love between parents and children. Every generational cause operating in your family line is terminated. Now somebody declare, by the power of the blood, my family is blessed. By the power of the blood, my marriage is restored. By the power of the blood, my children shall be mighty. By the power of the blood, no cause shall prevail against us. Let me speak over your destiny. The Bible says in Jeremiah 29:11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you an expected end. Your destiny will not be aborted. Every manipulation designed to exchange your star, every witchcraft designed to truncate your assignment, every satanic network contending against hear me child of God. Psalm 68:1 says, "Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered." Therefore, I command, let God arise in your life. Let God arise in your business. Let God arise in your ministry. Let God arise in your family. And as he arises, let every enemy scatter. Let every stronghold collapse. Let every barrier break. This is your day of freedom. Shout it loud. I am free. I am free. >> I am free. >> I am free. >> In the name of Jesus. Beloved, pay attention. Tonight is not an ordinary night. There are battles that must be won before the dawn. Psalm 27:2 declares, "When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell." By this scripture I decree, every evil spirit that has risen against your destiny, let them stumble and fall, every hand lifted against you in witchcraft, sorcery, enchantment, or divination, let that hand wither by fire in the name of Jesus. I speak as a servant of the Lord. Isaiah 54:15-17 says, "Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me. Whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, sayaeth the Lord. Therefore, I decree and declare, every gathering of darkness against you is scattered now. Every voice that has risen to speak against you in judgment is condemned now. Every weapon fashioned against your life, your family, your business, your destiny shall not prosper. I declare, let fire fall upon every satanic altar speaking against you. Let fire fall upon every shrine where your name has been mentioned. Let fire fall upon every coven where your destiny has been discussed. Let fire fall upon every occultic gathering, blotting against your rising. The blood of Jesus silences them now. I decree and declare, you are free from evil agreements. You are free from satanic yolks. You are free from foundational causes. You are free from the power of darkness. Colossians 2:14-15 says, "Blottting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, mailing it to his cross, and having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shoe of them openly, triumphing over them in it." Tonight, every handwriting against your life is blotted out by the cross. Every ordinance working against you is canled. Every power holding you bound is spoiled. I prophesy doors of deliverance are opening. Chains are breaking. Curses are reversing. Captives are being set free. The angel of the Lord is moving into your family right now. The angel of the Lord is entering your business, your marriage, your career. Every spirit of delay is arrested. Every spirit of limitation is destroyed. Every demonic embgo is lifted. Now I decree divine restoration. Joel 2:25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palma, my great army which I sent among you. By this word I command, let there be restoration of wasted years, restoration of missed opportunities, restoration of lost glory, restoration of stolen blessings, restoration of scattered relationships, restoration of broken health, restoration of peace in your home, restoration of joy in your soul. Lift your voice and shout restoration. Resto, >> restoration, >> restoration in the name of Jesus. Just serve the spirit of God. Someone listening to me now, the enemy has kept you in one place for years, but the power of God is moving you forward. Another person, the spirit of witchcraft has kept your family in cycles of sickness and failure, but tonight that cycle is broken. Another person, the enemy fired an arrow of disappointment at the edge of breakthrough, but I return it back to sender. By the power of God, every evil arrow goes back to where it came from. The Bible says in Psalm 18:44 to 45, lift your hands and thank the Lord for answered prayers. Declare, "Father, I thank you because my enemies are defeated. I thank you because my captivity is turned. I thank you because restoration has come. I thank you because no weapon formed against me shall prosper. I thank you because every evil altar is destroyed. I thank you because my life is preserved. I thank you because I walk into open doors. I thank you because I am blessed. I am lifted. I am free. And so in the name that is above every name, the name of Jesus, I seal these prayers with the blood of Jesus. I decree that your victory is permanent. I decree that your deliverance is sealed. I decree that your testimonies are established. Go and prosper. Go and rise. Go and take territories. Go and manifest dominion. And let the church shout a loud amen. Amen. >> Beloved, let us press further. The anointing tonight is not just for deliverance, but also for prosperity. For what use is it to be free from evil spirits and altars, yet still remain bound in poverty, lack, and insufficiency? Deuteronomy 8:18 declares, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which he swear unto thy fathers as it is this day." I decree and declare tonight, the Lord is releasing upon you, the power to get wealth. No more empty hands. No more struggling without results. The power of God is lifting you from scarcity to overflow. I announce prophetically according to Psalm 23:1, "The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. I decree and declare you will not want again." That lack that has followed your family for generations. That insufficiency that has tied down your progress. That mockery of where is your God? It is broken tonight. You shall not want for food. You shall not want for clothing. You shall not want for shelter. You shall not want for opportunities. Lift your voice and shout. By the power of God, I break free from financial stagation. Psalm 112:3 declares, "Wealth and I decree and declare you will enjoy favor with men and favor with God." Luke 2:52 says, "And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature and in favor with God and man." From tonight, may that grace of favor rest upon you. Wherever you go, let doors open of their own accord. Wherever you go, may men rise to help you. May strangers bring resources into your hands. May kings and nobles remember you for good. Thus saith the spirit of God, someone under the sound of my voice has labored for years with no reward, but your book of remembrance is being opened tonight. Another person, every time money enters your hand, calamity arises to waste it. From tonight that cycle is broken. You will gather and you will enjoy. You will build and you will inhabit. You will plant and you will eat the food thereof. >> Isaiah 45 2-3 says, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. And I will give thee the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel. By this word I decree and declare, every gate of brass standing between you and your wealth is broken. Every bar of iron blocking your opportunities is caught as sunder. Let the treasures of darkness be released to you. Let hidden riches in secret places be unveiled. The Lord who calls you by name is releasing strange financial miracles to your life. Lift your voice and declare, "Father, I receive treasures in darkness. Father, I receive hidden riches in secret places. Father, I receive open doors that no man can shut. I prophesy businesses that have been struggling will begin to flourish. Careers that have been stagnant will begin to rise. Ministries that have been limited will begin to expand. Families that have been mocked will begin to laugh. You will move from being a borrower to being a lender. You will move from being a beggar to being a distributor. You will move from being in lack to being a kingdom finance. I see in the spirit angels of financial favor being released. They are carrying blessings to men and women under the sound of my voice. They are carrying contracts, approvals, promotions, scholarships, properties, and inheritances. Let there be sudden open doors in the name of Jesus. Now by the authority of scripture, I decree restoration. Job 42:10 says, "And the Lord turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends. Also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before. By this word, I commanded double portion restoration upon your life. Whatever the enemy stole, be it money, opportunities, time, relationships, or health, I decree double restoration. Where you lost one job, may you receive two better jobs. Where you lost one contract, may you secure two greater contracts. Where you lost one opportunity, may God bring you two higher opportunities. Beloved, rejoice in advance, for the siege is broken. Rejoice in advance for the chains are loosed. Rejoice in advance for your heavens are open. Rejoice in advance for your wealth is released. Shout it loud. From scarcity to overflow. From lack to abundance. From closed doors to open doors. From borrowing to lending. From insufficiency to prosperity. And I decree according to Malachi 3:10, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, sayeth the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it." By this word I prophesy, the windows of heaven open over you. The devourer is rebuked. Your land becomes delightsome. Nations will call you blessed. Father, thank you for answering us. Thank you for open doors. Thank you for financial breakthroughs. Thank you for strange favor. Thank you for turning the captivity of your people. Blessed be your name forever. The spirit of the Lord is saying tonight that every altar of delay, every altar of manipulation, every altar of poverty, and every altar of witchcraft raised against your life must scatter by fire. Psalm 11:6 declares, "Upon the lift your voice and declare, by the blood of Jesus, I cancel every evil counsel against my life. By the fire of God, I scatter every gathering against my family. By divine authority, I frustrate the tokens of liars. Hear me. Isaiah 49:24-25 says, "Shall the prey be taken from the mighty or the lawful captive delivered? But thus sayeth the Lord, even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered. For I will contend with him that contended with thee, and I will save thy children. Tonight, whoever has contended with you in the spirit. Whoever has vowed that you will not rise. Whoever has tied your children, your health, your job, your promotion to their evil altar, the Lord contends with them now. Let every lawful captive be delivered. Let every prey of the mighty be released. Let every chain holding you bound break in the name of Jesus. Some of you have been experiencing strange attacks in your dreams, eating in dreams, being chased, seeing dead relatives, engaging in strange battles by the word of the Lord. Those dream attacks are terminated now according to Matthew 13:25. But while men slept, his enemy came and swed tears among the wheat and went his way. Every seed of the enemy planted while you slept is uprooted now. Every arrow fired while you slept is returned to send. Every manipulation against your sleep is destroyed. Lift your hands and declare, "Father, I recover my night seasons. Father, I take dominion over my dreams. Father, let every evil arrow backfire. The Lord says in Isaiah 54:17, "No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, sayaeth the Lord. I decree and declare, every weapon of sickness formed against you will not prosper. Every weapon of poverty formed against you will not prosper. Every weapon of shame formed against you will not prosper. Every weapon of untimely death formed against you will not prosper. Every evil tongue speaking against you, beloved, we invoke Psalm 35:1-6. Plead my cause, oh Lord, with them that strive with me. Fight against them that fight against me. Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help. Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me. Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation. Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul. Let them be turned back and brought to confusion that divides my heart. Let them be as chaff before the wind. And let the angel of the Lord chase them. Let their way be dark and slippery. And let the angel of the Lord persecute them. By this word I decree, let the angel of the Lord chase your enemies. Let the angel of the Lord pursue those who have vowed to destroy your destiny. Let their way be dark and slippery. Let them fall into the pits they have dug. Let them eat the fruit of their lips. Let their evil arrows return to their own camp. I prophesy according to Oadiah 11:17. But upon Mount Zion shall be deliverance, and there shall be holiness, and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions. Tonight you are on Mount Zion. Therefore, there is deliverance for you. There is holiness for you. There is restoration for you. I decree possess your possessions. Possess your health. Possess your marriage. Possess your children. Possess your finances. Possess your open doors. Possess your breakthroughs. Lift your voice and declare by fire. I possess my possessions. By the blood of Jesus, I take what belongs to me. By divine authority, I recover all. Beloved, Psalm 68:1 says, "Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him." I decree. Let God arise on your behalf tonight. Let his enemies scatter. Let them flee before you. Let them melt like ws before the fire. Let every demonic power opposing your advancement be consumed in the name of Jesus. Now I release angelic intervention over your life. Hebrews 1:14 says, "Are they not all ministering spirit?
